literal: Under Mingdi, the superior title Empress Dowager was further raised, like Han and Jin institutions, rectifying aunt and daughter-in-law ritual; temple title as before Wenzhao.
idiomatic: Under Mingdi, the superior title empress dowager was further raised, like Han and Jin institutions, rectifying aunt and daughter-in-law ritual; temple title as before Wenzhao.

literal: The spirit coffin was moved within Changling's precinct northwest sixty paces.
idiomatic: The spirit coffin was moved within Changling's precinct northwest sixty paces.

literal: At first, opening Zhongning Tomb several zhang, on the inner coffin a great serpent more than a zhang, black, head bearing the character wang, coiled without moving;
idiomatic: At first, opening Zhongning Tomb several zhang, on the inner coffin a great serpent more than a zhang, black, head bearing the character wang, coiled without moving;

literal: when the spirit coffin was moved, the serpent was returned to its old place.
idiomatic: when the spirit coffin was moved, the serpent was returned to its old place.

literal: Xuanwu Shun Empress Yu was daughter of Lie's younger brother Jin.
idiomatic: Xuanwu Shun Empress Yu was daughter of Lie's younger brother Jin.

literal: When Xuanwu first personally handled government, Lie was then commander-in-chief, holding the heart-and-liver charge.
idiomatic: When Xuanwu first personally handled government, Lie was then commander-in-chief, holding the heart-and-liver charge.

literal: Because pin and attendants were not complete, attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and virtue—the emperor then welcomed her as noble lady.
idiomatic: Because pin and attendants were not complete, attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and virtue—the emperor then welcomed her as noble lady.

literal: Age fourteen; she was greatly favored and established empress.
idiomatic: Age fourteen; she was greatly favored and established empress.

literal: The empress was silent, tolerant, and by nature not jealous.
idiomatic: The empress was silent, tolerant, and by nature not jealous.

literal: She bore a prince; at three years he died young.
idiomatic: She bore a prince; at three years he died young.

literal: Afterward she died suddenly; palace affairs were secret—none could know fully; worldly opinion blamed Lady Gao.
idiomatic: Afterward she died suddenly; palace affairs were secret—none could know fully; worldly opinion blamed Lady Gao.

literal: Buried at Yongtai Tomb; posthumous title Shun Empress.
idiomatic: Buried at Yongtai Tomb; posthumous title Shun Empress.

literal: Xuanwu Empress Gao was daughter of Wenzhao Empress's younger brother Yan.
idiomatic: Xuanwu Empress Gao was daughter of Wenzhao Empress's younger brother Yan.

literal: Xuanwu took her as noble consort; she bore a prince who died young;
idiomatic: Xuanwu took her as noble consort; she bore a prince who died young;

literal: also bore Princess of Jiande.
idiomatic: also bore Princess of Jiande.

literal: Later she was made empress; greatly honored in ritual.
idiomatic: Later she was made empress; greatly honored in ritual.

literal: Jealous by nature; palace women rarely won access.
idiomatic: Jealous by nature; palace women rarely won access.

literal: When Mingdi took the throne, she was honored Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: When Mingdi took the throne, she was honored empress dowager.

literal: Soon she became a nun at Yaoguang Temple.
idiomatic: Soon she became a nun at Yaoguang Temple.

literal: Except great festivals she did not enter the palace.
idiomatic: Except great festivals she did not enter the palace.

literal: Princess of Jiande was only five or six; Empress Dowager Ling went out to visit her mother Lady of Wuyi; at the time astronomy had a change; the empress dowager wished to use it as calamity—that night she died suddenly; the realm resented it.
idiomatic: Princess of Jiande was only five or six; Empress Dowager Ling went out to visit her mother Lady of Wuyi; at the time astronomy had a change; the empress dowager wished to use it as calamity—that night she died suddenly; the realm resented it.

literal: The coffin returned to Yaoguang Buddhist Temple; burial all used nun ritual.
idiomatic: The coffin returned to Yaoguang Buddhist Temple; burial all used nun ritual.

literal: At first when Xiaowen You Empress was favored, he wished to monopolize her love; rear-palace access was much blocked.
idiomatic: At first when Xiaowen You Empress was favored, he wished to monopolize her love; rear-palace access was much blocked.

literal: Xiaowen spoke to close ministers, saying women's jealousy and guard—even kings cannot avoid it, how much more gentlemen and commoners.
idiomatic: Xiaowen spoke to close ministers, saying women's jealousy and guard—even kings cannot avoid it, how much more gentlemen and commoners.

literal: Xuanwu's Empress Gao was fierce and jealous; pin and attendants often to the emperor's death did not receive attendance.
idiomatic: Xuanwu's Empress Gao was fierce and jealous; pin and attendants often to the emperor's death did not receive attendance.

literal: Therefore at Luo for more than twenty years, among princes fully reared there was only Mingdi.
idiomatic: Therefore at Luo for more than twenty years, among princes fully reared there was only Mingdi.

literal: Xuanwu Ling Empress Hu was a man of Linjing in Anding, daughter of Minister of State Guozhen.
idiomatic: Xuanwu Ling Empress Hu was a man of Linjing in Anding, daughter of Minister of State Guozhen.

literal: Mother Lady Huangfu; on the day the empress was born, red light shone on four sides.
idiomatic: Mother Lady Huangfu; on the day the empress was born, red light shone on four sides.

literal: In Shanyang county north of the capital was Zhao Hu, skilled at divination; Guozhen asked him; Hu said: "The worthy daughter has great honor's signs—she will be Heaven and Earth's mother, bear Heaven and Earth's lord—do not let more than three know."
idiomatic: In Shanyang county north of the capital was Zhao Hu, skilled at divination; Guozhen asked him; Hu said, "The worthy daughter has great honor's signs—she will be Heaven and Earth's mother, bear Heaven and Earth's lord—do not let more than three know."

literal: The empress's aunt was a nun and could expound the Way.
idiomatic: The empress's aunt was a nun and could expound the Way.

literal: At the beginning of Xuanwu she entered to lecture in the forbidden inner palace.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuanwu she entered to lecture in the forbidden inner palace.

literal: After years attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and conduct.
idiomatic: After years attendants admonished, saying the empress had bearing and conduct.

literal: The emperor heard and summoned her into the rear apartments as chonghua world wife.
idiomatic: The emperor heard and summoned her into the rear apartments as chonghua world wife.

literal: In the pepper chambers by state old system they prayed together, all wishing to bear kings and princesses, not wishing to bear the crown prince.
idiomatic: In the pepper chambers by state old system they prayed together, all wishing to bear kings and princesses, not wishing to bear the crown prince.

literal: Only the empress each time said: "Ladies say—why fear one body's death and make the royal house bear no tomb heir?"
idiomatic: Only the empress each time said, "Ladies say—why fear one body's death and make the royal house bear no tomb heir?"

literal: When Mingdi was in the womb, her peers still by precedent frightened her and urged various schemes.
idiomatic: When Mingdi was in the womb, her peers still by precedent frightened her and urged various schemes.

literal: The empress's intent was firm; in dark night she alone vowed—only let what she bore be male; in order he should be eldest son; when the son was born, she would not refuse death.
idiomatic: The empress's intent was firm; in dark night she alone vowed—only let what she bore be male; in order he should be eldest son; when the son was born, she would not refuse death.

literal: When Mingdi was born, she was advanced to chonghua pin.
idiomatic: When Mingdi was born, she was advanced to chonghua pin.

literal: Earlier Xuanwu repeatedly lost princes; himself thinking he was advanced in years, he deeply added careful guard; wet-nurses were chosen from good families with fit sons, reared in a separate palace—empress and chonghua all could not nurture and view.
idiomatic: Earlier Xuanwu repeatedly lost princes; himself thinking he was advanced in years, he deeply added careful guard; wet-nurses were chosen from good families with fit sons, reared in a separate palace—empress and chonghua all could not nurture and view.

literal: When Mingdi took the throne, the empress was honored Grand Imperial Consort; the empress dowager was honored empress dowager.
idiomatic: When Mingdi took the throne, the empress was honored grand imperial consort; the empress dowager was honored empress dowager.

literal: She held court and heard government, still saying Hall Below; orders were issued as commands.
idiomatic: She held court and heard government, still saying Hall Below; orders were issued as commands.

literal: The empress dowager changed orders to edicts; ministers' memorials said Your Majesty; she called herself zhen.
idiomatic: The empress dowager changed orders to edicts; ministers' memorials said Your Majesty; she called herself zhen.

literal: The empress dowager, because Mingdi was young and could not personally sacrifice, wished beside Zhou Rites' lady and lord mutual presenting meaning to substitute in performing sacrifice.
idiomatic: The empress dowager, because Mingdi was young and could not personally sacrifice, wished beside Zhou Rites' lady and lord mutual presenting meaning to substitute in performing sacrifice.

literal: Ritual officers broadly debated it as impossible; yet the empress dowager wished to screen herself with curtains and observe the three dukes' conduct.
idiomatic: Ritual officers broadly debated it as impossible; yet the empress dowager wished to screen herself with curtains and observe the three dukes' conduct.

literal: She again asked Attendant-in-Chief Cui Guang; Guang then cited Han Emperor He and Empress Dowager Deng's presenting sacrifice precedent.
idiomatic: She again asked Attendant-in-Chief Cui Guang; Guang then cited Han Emperor He and Empress Dowager Deng's presenting sacrifice precedent.

literal: The empress dowager greatly rejoiced and then held the first sacrifice in proxy.
idiomatic: The empress dowager greatly rejoiced and then held the first sacrifice in proxy.

literal: The empress dowager was intelligent and comprehending, with many talents and arts; her aunt had been a nun; from youth depending on her, she roughly grasped Buddhist scriptures' great meaning.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was intelligent and comprehending, with many talents and arts; her aunt had been a nun; from youth depending on her, she roughly grasped Buddhist scriptures' great meaning.

literal: She personally viewed the myriad tasks and decided with her own hand.
idiomatic: She personally viewed the myriad tasks and decided with her own hand.

literal: Visiting Xilin Garden's Faliu Hall, she ordered attendants to shoot; those who could not were punished.
idiomatic: Visiting Xilin Garden's Faliu Hall, she ordered attendants to shoot; those who could not were punished.

literal: Also she herself shot at a needle's hole—hit it; greatly pleased, she bestowed left and right cloth and silk in grades.
idiomatic: Also she herself shot at a needle's hole—hit it; greatly pleased, she bestowed left and right cloth and silk in grades.

literal: Earlier the empress dowager ordered built the appeal carriage; at the time she rode it.
idiomatic: Earlier the empress dowager ordered built the appeal carriage; at the time she rode it.

literal: Out from Yunlong Grand Marshal Gate, from the palace's northwest, entering by Qianqiu Gate, to receive wrongful suits.
idiomatic: Out from Yunlong Grand Marshal Gate, from the palace's northwest, entering by Qianqiu Gate, to receive wrongful suits.

literal: Also she personally examined filial and excellent prefectural and commandery clerks in the court hall.
idiomatic: Also she personally examined filial and excellent prefectural and commandery clerks in the court hall.

literal: The empress dowager with Mingdi visited Hualin Garden, feasting ministers at Duting's winding water, ordering kings and dukes and below to compose seven-character poems.
idiomatic: The empress dowager with Mingdi visited Hualin Garden, feasting ministers at Duting's winding water, ordering kings and dukes and below to compose seven-character poems.

literal: The empress dowager's poem said: "Transforming light creating things, containing qi and upright."
idiomatic: The empress dowager's poem said, "Transforming light creating things, containing qi and upright."

literal: Mingdi's poem said: "Respectfully oneself without action, relying on kind excellence."
idiomatic: Mingdi's poem said, "Respectfully oneself without action, relying on kind excellence."

literal: Kings and dukes and below received cloth and silk in grades.
idiomatic: Kings and dukes and below received cloth and silk in grades.

literal: The empress dowager's father died; the hundred officials memorialized requesting public mourning leave; the empress dowager did not permit.
idiomatic: The empress dowager's father died; the hundred officials memorialized requesting public mourning leave; the empress dowager did not permit.

literal: Soon she visited Yongning Temple, viewing a stupa built on a nine-tier foundation; monks, nuns, gentlemen and ladies who came numbered tens of thousands.
idiomatic: Soon she visited Yongning Temple, viewing a stupa built on a nine-tier foundation; monks, nuns, gentlemen and ladies who came numbered tens of thousands.

literal: When re-burying Wenzhao Empress Gao, the empress dowager did not wish Mingdi to preside; she herself was mourning chief.
idiomatic: When re-burying Wenzhao Empress Gao, the empress dowager did not wish Mingdi to preside; she herself was mourning chief.

literal: Going out to Zhongning Tomb, she personally offered the sending-off; returning to weep at Taiji Hall—until the affair ended, all was self-directed.
idiomatic: Going out to Zhongning Tomb, she personally offered the sending-off; returning to weep at Taiji Hall—until the affair ended, all was self-directed.

literal: The empress dowager visited Song Mountain; ladies, nine pin, princesses and below who followed numbered several hundred; they ascended the summit.
idiomatic: The empress dowager visited Song Mountain; ladies, nine pin, princesses and below who followed numbered several hundred; they ascended the summit.

literal: Profligate shrines were abolished; the Hu Heaven god was not in that category.
idiomatic: Profligate shrines were abolished; the Hu Heaven god was not in that category.

literal: Soon she visited Quekou hot springs, ascended Cock-head Mountain, herself shot an ivory hairpin—one shot hit it; edict shown to civil and military.
idiomatic: Soon she visited Quekou hot springs, ascended Cock-head Mountain, herself shot an ivory hairpin—one shot hit it; edict shown to civil and military.

literal: At the time the empress dowager forced favor on Prince of Qinghe Yi; wanton disorder and passion unrestrained—hated by the realm.
idiomatic: At the time the empress dowager forced favor on Prince of Qinghe Yi; wanton disorder and passion unrestrained—hated by the realm.

literal: Commander-in-Chief Yuan Cha and Chief of Autumn Liu Teng and others presented Mingdi at Xianyang Hall; the empress dowager was confined in the North Palace; Yi was killed in the forbidden inner palace.
idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Yuan Cha and Chief of Autumn Liu Teng and others presented Mingdi at Xianyang Hall; the empress dowager was confined in the North Palace; Yi was killed in the forbidden inner palace.

literal: Later the empress dowager's sister's son Commander-in-Chief Sengjing with bodyguard Zhang Chequ and others several tens plotted to kill Cha and again present the empress dowager to hold court.
idiomatic: Later the empress dowager's sister's son commander-in-chief Sengjing with bodyguard Zhang Chequ and others several tens plotted to kill Cha and again present the empress dowager to hold court.

literal: The affair did not succeed; Sengjing was condemned to frontier exile; Chequ and the rest died; many of the Hu clan were dismissed.
idiomatic: The affair did not succeed; Sengjing was condemned to frontier exile; Chequ and the rest died; many of the Hu clan were dismissed.

literal: Later Mingdi attended the empress dowager at Xilin Garden, feasting civil and military attendants; drinking until evening; Cha then rose before the empress dowager and stated himself—outside it was said the empress dowager wished to harm him and Teng.
idiomatic: Later Mingdi attended the empress dowager at Xilin Garden, feasting civil and military attendants; drinking until evening; Cha then rose before the empress dowager and stated himself—outside it was said the empress dowager wished to harm him and Teng.

literal: The empress dowager answered: "There is no such word."
idiomatic: The empress dowager answered, "There is no such word."

literal: It reached extreme drunkenness.
idiomatic: It reached extreme drunkenness.

literal: The empress dowager then rose, took Mingdi's hand off the hall, saying: "Mother and son cannot long gather—this evening share one night—great ministers send me in."
idiomatic: The empress dowager then rose, took Mingdi's hand off the hall, saying, "Mother and son cannot long gather—this evening share one night—great ministers send me in."

literal: The empress dowager and emperor went to the northeast small pavilion; Left Guard General Xi Kangsheng plotted to kill Cha without success.
idiomatic: The empress dowager and emperor went to the northeast small pavilion; Left Guard General Xi Kangsheng plotted to kill Cha without success.

literal: From Liu Teng's death, Cha again grew lax; the empress dowager with Mingdi and Prince of Gaoyang Yong made a plan and removed Cha from command.
idiomatic: From Liu Teng's death, Cha again grew lax; the empress dowager with Mingdi and Prince of Gaoyang Yong made a plan and removed Cha from command.

literal: The empress dowager again held court; great amnesty and changed the era name.
idiomatic: The empress dowager again held court; great amnesty and changed the era name.

literal: From this court government grew slack; might and favor were not established; prefects and shepherds everywhere were greedy.
idiomatic: From this court government grew slack; might and favor were not established; prefects and shepherds everywhere were greedy.

literal: Zheng Yan defiled the palace; power tilted over the seas;
idiomatic: Zheng Yan defiled the palace; power tilted over the seas;

literal: Li Shengui and Xu He were both intimately attended; within one or two years posts held all critical keys.
idiomatic: Li Shengui and Xu He were both intimately attended; within one or two years posts held all critical keys.

literal: Holding royal ranks in hand, weight and light in heart; wantonness in court—filthied by the four quarters.
idiomatic: Holding royal ranks in hand, weight and light in heart; wantonness in court—filthied by the four quarters.

literal: Civil and military dissolved; everywhere rebellion; earth collapsed and fish rotted—from this it came.
idiomatic: Civil and military dissolved; everywhere rebellion; earth collapsed and fish rotted—from this it came.

literal: Sengjing again at a clan gathering wept and admonished: "Your Majesty mother-model over the seas—how can you lightly cast off thus!"
idiomatic: Sengjing again at a clan gathering wept and admonished, "Your Majesty mother-model over the seas—how can you lightly cast off thus!"

literal: The empress dowager greatly angered; from then she did not summon Sengjing.
idiomatic: The empress dowager greatly angered; from then she did not summon Sengjing.

literal: Inwardly forming factions, guarding against and blocking ears and eyes—those Mingdi favored, the empress dowager mostly harmed by affairs.
idiomatic: Inwardly forming factions, guarding against and blocking ears and eyes—those Mingdi favored, the empress dowager mostly harmed by affairs.

literal: There was the monk Miduo, able in Hu language; the emperor placed him at his side.
idiomatic: There was the monk Miduo, able in Hu language; the emperor placed him at his side.

literal: The empress dowager feared he would transmit news; on the third day of the third month, in the great lane south of the city she killed him—just as a reward for catching thieves was posted.
idiomatic: The empress dowager feared he would transmit news; on the third day of the third month, in the great lane south of the city she killed him—just as a reward for catching thieves was posted.

literal: Also in the forbidden palace she killed Director of Attendants and Chamberlain for Dependencies Gu Hui and Shao Da—also those the emperor favored.
idiomatic: Also in the forbidden palace she killed Director of Attendants and Chamberlain for Dependencies Gu Hui and Shao Da—also those the emperor favored.

literal: Between mother and son, rifts arose repeatedly.
idiomatic: Between mother and son, rifts arose repeatedly.

literal: Zheng Yan feared disaster; then with the empress dowager schemed—because Consort Pan bore a girl, falsely saying a prince, then great amnesty, Wutai first year, again secretly administered poison.
idiomatic: Zheng Yan feared disaster; then with the empress dowager schemed—because Consort Pan bore a girl, falsely saying a prince, then great amnesty, Wutai first year, again secretly administered poison.

literal: That year in the second month Mingdi died suddenly; then they presented Consort Pan's girl, saying the crown prince took the throne.
idiomatic: That year in the second month Mingdi died suddenly; then they presented Consort Pan's girl, saying the crown prince took the throne.

literal: After several days, seeing men's hearts were settled, they then said Consort Pan had truly borne a girl—now one should choose another heir; then they established Prince of Linzi Zhaozhu as lord, age only two or three— the realm was startled.
idiomatic: After several days, seeing men's hearts were settled, they then said Consort Pan had truly borne a girl—now one should choose another heir; then they established Prince of Linzi Zhaozhu as lord, age only two or three—the realm was startled.

literal: When Erzhu Rong raised troops crossing the river, the empress dowager summoned all Mingdi's six palaces to enter the Way; the empress dowager also shaved her head.
idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong raised troops crossing the river, the empress dowager summoned all Mingdi's six palaces to enter the Way; the empress dowager also shaved her head.

literal: Rong sent riders to seize and send the empress dowager and the young lord to Heyin.
idiomatic: Rong sent riders to seize and send the empress dowager and the young lord to Heyin.

literal: The empress dowager to Rong made many explanations; Rong brushed his robe and rose.
idiomatic: The empress dowager to Rong made many explanations; Rong brushed his robe and rose.

literal: The empress dowager and young lord were both sunk in the river.
idiomatic: The empress dowager and young lord were both sunk in the river.

literal: The empress dowager's younger sister Lady of Fengyi collected burial at Shuangling Temple.
idiomatic: The empress dowager's younger sister Lady of Fengyi collected burial at Shuangling Temple.

literal: Under Wudi, she was first buried with empress ritual; posthumous title Ling was added.
idiomatic: Under Wudi, she was first buried with empress ritual; posthumous title Ling was added.

literal: Xiaoming Empress Hu was daughter of the empress dowager's cousin, Inspector of Jizhou Sheng.
idiomatic: Xiaoming Empress Hu was daughter of the empress dowager's cousin, inspector of Jizhou Sheng.

literal: The empress dowager wished to honor the clan's weight; therefore she was established empress.
idiomatic: The empress dowager wished to honor the clan's weight; therefore she was established empress.

literal: Mingdi had much wine virtue; he exclusively favored chonghua Pan; the empress and pin and attendants all had no excess favor.
idiomatic: Mingdi had much wine virtue; he exclusively favored chonghua Pan; the empress and pin and attendants all had no excess favor.

literal: The empress dowager chose and accepted matches for the emperor, suppressing and bending the flow of men.
idiomatic: The empress dowager chose and accepted matches for the emperor, suppressing and bending the flow of men.
